author: Akosa Samuel Onyejekwe (independent)
purpose: Which measured frames may be used to fit model constants (calibration) and which may only be predicted (held_out). Fixed before any model change and not altered afterwards.

rule_for_frames_added_later.statement: A frame added after this date is assigned by its frame number alone, before its data are examined. NACA 0012: frame number divisible by 3 -> calibration, otherwise held_out. Any other aerofoil: other_airfoil (its static polar calibrates the separation law; the dynamic constants stay fixed, so its frames are never fitted).

uses_permitted.calibration: fitting constants, choosing model form, attached-flow acceptance checks
